prompt: Create one photorealistic live-action reference still, 16:9, for a historical documentary reenactment set in Tozawa Village, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan, on May 25, 1988. Match the supplied image's composition: an oblique side view of a steep forest bank occupying the left and center, with a rocky flowing stream below on the right. A broad strip of flattened, tangled green bamboo grass descends diagonally from the upper-left bank toward the lower-right stream bed. Disturbed soil, exposed roots, and scattered small stones make the downward route clearly visible. Keep the disturbed ground irregular and natural, without perfectly parallel tracks or identifiable footprints. Surround the bank with dense late-May foliage and beech and cedar trees. Soft daylight filtered through the canopy, subdued natural greens and browns, realistic soil and leaf textures, clear detail in the shadows. Frame the upper edge of the bank and the descent toward the stream together, allowing a later video camera movement to follow the flattened vegetation downward. Show only the empty landscape and disturbed vegetation; do not depict the attack or fall. No people, bodies, bears, blood, injuries, belongings, or added props. No snow, frost, dramatic fog, artificial lighting, text, subtitles, logos, or watermarks. Authentic location-photography appearance, natural perspective, 35mm lens, no illustration or CGI look.
explanation: 参照画像の斜面と右側の沢の構図を維持し、5月の襲撃・転落を倒れた笹と乱れた土だけで示す実写風の静止画です。後で上から下へ追える構図にし、人物や台本にない所持品は加えません。
